dict.string: listn captures system audio so it can transcribe meetings and other sound playing on this Mac. Audio stays on this computer.
listn uses the microphone so your own voice is included in the transcript and labelled as you. Audio stays on this computer.
listn reads your calendars to title a recording with the meeting that is happening now and to attach its attendees. Events stay on this Mac.
